title: ReStreet (FIFA Street 2012 on PC) now has a Discord, and the online beta is coming soon!
author: Lucky-Concentrate798
selftext:
Hi everyone!

About a week ago I released ReStreet, a free offline port of FIFA Street (2012) for Windows PC (you bring your own Xbox 360 ISO). Since then a lot of you asked about online play, so here's the update:

**THE COMMUNITY SERVER IS OPEN**

I've created a Discord for the project. It has downloads, help with installing, bug reports, a place to share gameplay, and the dev log.

[https://discord.gg/CqjYMGKyy2](https://discord.gg/CqjYMGKyy2)

**ONLINE BETA COMING SOON**

Online play is working in my tests and I'm preparing a beta test. There's no date yet. If you want to take part, join the Discord and ask for access in the beta channel. That's how I'll organize the testers and send the online installer, so everybody is on the same version.

**A few things to know:**

\- The test server is in Europe. If you're in another region you can still try it, but expect higher ping.

\- It's an early test, so expect bugs and downtime. Your feedback will help a lot.

\- You'll need the latest version of ReStreet and your own copy of the game.LINKS

**Download the latest version** (offline): [https://github.com/samuelit0davila/fifa-street-pc-port/releases/latest](https://github.com/samuelit0davila/fifa-street-pc-port/releases/latest)

**Gameplay video:** [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FiwdAOIHGFY](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FiwdAOIHGFY)

**Discord:** [https://discord.gg/CqjYMGKyy2](https://discord.gg/CqjYMGKyy2)

**Thanks to everyone who tested it and sent feedback. See you in the server!**
